member.name: T:Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.ExternalAccess.TestDiscovery.Contracts.ITestDiscoveryLanguageService
member.summary:
Minimal, service contract for initializing source-based test discovery.
The discovery RPC contract is defined in the C# Dev Kit project so the discovery surface can evolve without changing Roslyn. The only stable coupling between Roslyn and C# Dev Kit is the service descriptor ().
The implementation is exported via [ExportWorkspaceService(typeof(ITestDiscoveryLanguageService))] and resolved from the host workspace.

member.name: T:Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.ExternalAccess.TestDiscovery.Internal.TestDiscoveryServiceContributor
member.summary: Registers and proffers the source-based test discovery brokered service. The proffered service object is the workspace service which also implements the rich discovery RPC interface defined in the C# Dev Kit contracts assembly. The wire descriptor is supplied by the implementation (), so Roslyn never needs to know the concrete RPC interface or its serialization details. When the implementation is not present (for example, a C# extension build that does not ship the Dev Kit discovery component) nothing is registered or proffered.
